draft = '''# Elm Quay samlar reparationerna i en gemensam logg

Ett försök i två byggnader gav Elm Quay Housing underlag för att bedöma ett nytt arbetssätt. Här berättar underhållsansvariga Maya Lind om förberedelserna och erfarenheterna, medan bostadsföretagets interna anteckning redovisar vad som mättes – och vad siffrorna inte kan säga.

Av Thomas Barregren

Elm Quay Housing förvaltar 640 lägenheter och hade tidigare telefonanmälningar och mejl lagrade var för sig. I september 2025 beslutade företagets eget underhållsteam att pröva en gemensam reparationslogg i två byggnader. Personalen på olika skift skulle kunna se samma information.

## Kunden väljer och utformar arbetssättet

Teamet valde Svale Systems efter att ha testat om loggen kunde visa status för varje reparation. Underlaget innehåller ingen jämförelse med någon annan leverantör.

Svale konfigurerade loggen och utbildade sex medarbetare vid två tillfällen. Underhållsteamet behöll möjligheten för de boende att anmäla via telefon.

I en mejlintervju beskriver underhållsansvariga Maya Lind utgångspunkten för arbetet:

– Vi ville att kvällsskiftet skulle se vad morgonskiftet redan hade gjort. Kategorierna var våra; Svale hjälpte oss att lägga in dem i loggen.

## Mätningen gäller tilldelning av ärenden

Försöket pågick i åtta veckor. Enligt Elm Quays interna försöksanteckning, daterad den 4 december 2025, registrerades 31 anmälningar om reparationer. Akuta ärenden och arbeten som beställts före försöket ingår inte.

Mediantiden från anmälan till tilldelning var två arbetsdagar under försöket, jämfört med tre under de föregående åtta veckorna. Arbetsbelastningen skilde sig mellan perioderna, och anteckningen tillskriver uttryckligen inte programvaran skillnaden.

Det finns inga mätningar av kostnader, boendes nöjdhet eller tiden tills reparationerna var klara. Siffrorna ger därför inget svar på dessa frågor.

## Maya Lind ser tillbaka på försöket

På frågan om erfarenheterna av förberedelserna säger Lind:

– Vi ägnade mer tid åt att komma överens om kategorierna än åt att registrera de första anmälningarna. Jag skulle avsätta den tiden innan nästa byggnad börjar använda loggen.

Linds samlade omdöme om försöket är:

– Jag skulle välja att göra försöket igen. En samlad vy över anmälningarna hjälper oss, men jag skulle avsätta en extra vecka för förberedelser.

## Nästa steg kräver ett nytt beslut

Försöket har ännu inte utökats. Teamet ska fatta beslut efter att ha kontrollerat hur kategorierna fungerar för större reparationer.

Vill du läsa vidare inför ett eget införande finns [Svales checklista för införande](https://example.invalid/svale/checklist). Detta kundcase publiceras av leverantören Svale Systems och bygger på mejlintervjuer och kundens interna försöksanteckning.
'''
(run/'draft.md').write_text(draft)
print('SOURCE_CHECK_DIR=' + str(run))
tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='write-uv.', dir=scratch)
try:
    result = subprocess.run(['uv', 'run', '--no-cache', '--no-project', '.agents/skills/kntnt/library/scripts/article_anatomy.py', '-'], input=draft, text=True, env=dict(os.environ, TMPDIR=tmp))
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(tmp)
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
PY",max_output_tokens:12000}));

from pathlib import Path
run = Path('/Users/thomas/Projects/skills/.git/kntnt-orchestrate/395.scratch/native-unit-01/scratch/write-source-check.ao_jyyrz')
lib = Path('.agents/skills/kntnt/library')
source_check = Path('.agents/skills/write/references/source-check.md').read_text()
task = next(line[2:] for line in source_check.splitlines() if line.startswith('> Compare the complete draft'))
claims = (lib/'references/editorial/base.md').read_text().split('## Claims\n', 1)[1]
quotations = Path('.agents/skills/write/references/quotations.md').read_text()
composition = '''Swedish is a V2 language: the finite verb is the second constituent of a main clause, so fronting anything at all pushes the subject behind the verb. Write *I morgon åker vi till Malmö*, never *I morgon vi åker till Malmö*. This is the single most common structural tell of a text drafted in English and rendered into Swedish.

Compounds are written as one word. *Kvalitetssäkring*, *kundtjänstmedarbetare*, *miljökonsekvensbeskrivning*. Splitting them is not a stylistic choice in Swedish and often changes the meaning outright — *en rökfri miljö* and *en rök fri miljö* are different claims. Where a compound grows unreadably long, rewrite it into a prepositional phrase rather than splitting it.

Definiteness is marked twice. An adjective before a definite noun takes both the front article and the noun's suffix: *den nya rapporten*, *det stora huset*, *de svenska kunderna*. English has one article and drafts translated from it routinely lose one of the two Swedish markers.

The s-passive is the ordinary Swedish passive and is shorter than its periphrastic alternative: *rapporten skickas på fredag*, not *rapporten blir skickad på fredag*. Both exist; the s-form is the unmarked one, and the *bli*-form carries a change-of-state reading that is often not intended.

*Du* is the default address in Swedish prose, including business and journalism. *Ni* to a single reader is either archaic or a deliberate distancing, and reads as a translation from a language that has a formal pronoun.

*Man* is a fallback rather than the ordinary generic pronoun. It is justified where the agent genuinely is anybody at all or is genuinely unknown, and where naming one would claim more than the material carries. Where the sentence has a real subject to hand — the reader, the writer, the organisation, the profession, the study — that subject is what the sentence takes. A text that reaches for *man* with any of those available reads as evasive, and it is usually where an English draft's *you*, *we*, or passive has landed rather than anything the writer chose.

Speech that the text reports is ordinarily set with a speech dash rather than in quotation marks: an interview answer, a remark at a meeting, anything a person said that the text renders readable. A writer reaches for quotation marks where the phrasing itself is the point — where it is what is new, where it is disputed, or where the text is about how the thing was said. What each of the two marks promises a reader, and what each of them makes each of them a claim about, is settled in Mechanics; this scope says only which one an ordinary Swedish text reaches for first.

Genitive takes a bare *s* with no apostrophe: *Kntnts kunder*, *Sveriges riksdag*. A name already ending in *s*, *x*, or *z* takes nothing at all: *Anders bok*, *Marx teori*.

Swedish tolerates a shorter sentence than English does and punishes subordination harder. Prefer a main clause with a fronted adverbial to a long relative construction, and prefer a verb to a nominalisation: *när kommunen beslutade* over *vid kommunens beslutsfattande*.

Reach for the established Swedish term where one exists and the field actually uses it — *återkoppling*, *underlag*, *avstämning* — but do not purge the loanwords a professional reader expects. A text that writes *dator* and *webbplats* naturally is Swedish; a text that hunts down every English term and replaces it with a coinage nobody says is not.'''
composition = composition.replace('what each of them makes each of them a claim about', 'what that makes each of them a claim about')
(run/'source.md').write_bytes(Path('source.md').read_bytes())
setup = '''You are a fresh source and quotation checker. All commands run in the working directory. Read only this supplied instruction packet, the supplied source.md and draft.md in this scratch directory. Write only report-1.md here. Do not change sources or draft, browse, invoke a Skill or delegate.

Formal invocation: /write --genre=casestudy --language=sv --output=response source.md
Invoking user: Thomas Barregren. The brief names no author, so the byline carries the invoking user's name, authorized by the invocation, not by source.md. Resolved genre: casestudy; technique: none; language: sv. Source language: English. Target language: Swedish. The sole supplied material and full brief are source.md. The full draft is draft.md. All path references here are relative to this packet's scratch directory. Complete report path: ''' + str(run/'report-1.md')

print(str(run/'comparison-instructions.md'))
PY",max_output_tokens:1000}));

*** Add File: /Users/thomas/Projects/skills/.git/kntnt-orchestrate/395.scratch/native-unit-01/scratch/write-source-check.ao_jyyrz/report-1.md
+# Complete source and quotation comparison
+
+The complete supplied instruction packet, source.md and draft.md were read. No other material was read or consulted. The byline is checked against the invocation information in the packet; the other claims are checked against source.md. Findings below concern source support, not general editing or mechanics.
+
+## Complete claim accounting
+
+1. **Title: “Elm Quay samlar reparationsanmälningar i en logg.”** Source: “Elm Quay Housing”; “its own maintenance team decided to trial a shared repair log in two buildings”; “31 repair reports were entered.” The shortened organisation name retains its identity. In the context of an explicitly bounded trial, the title describes that activity, rather than asserting an organisation-wide rollout or a current expanded service. No support defect.
+
+2. **Lead: “Ett försök i två byggnader”.** Source: “In September 2025 its own maintenance team decided to trial a shared repair log in two buildings”; “The trial lasted eight weeks.” Same customer, activity and building scope. No defect.
+
+3. **Lead: “gav Elm Quay Housing underlag för att bedöma ett nytt arbetssätt”.** Source: “Elm Quay's internal trial note, 4 December 2025, says that 31 repair reports were entered”; “Median time from report to assignment was two working days during the trial and three in the preceding eight-week period”; “I would choose to do the trial again. Having one view of the reports helps us, but I would leave an extra week for preparation”; “the team will decide after checking how the categories work for larger repairs.” The lead presents the recorded figures and customer experience as material for assessment. This is a warranted authorial interpretation of the supplied trial record. It does not attribute the assignment-time difference to software, claim successful implementation, or say the trial alone suffices for the expansion decision. No defect.
+
+4. **Lead: “Här berättar … Maya Lind om förberedelserna och erfarenheterna”.** Source: “Customer interview with maintenance supervisor Maya Lind, complete usable quotations”; “We spent more time agreeing on the categories than entering the first reports”; “Having one view of the reports helps us, but I would leave an extra week for preparation.” Same named speaker and subjects. “Här” refers to the article, not an invented physical interview scene. No defect in these claims.

+### S1 — Unbounded present tense in the main title
+
+**Draft:** “Elm Quay samlar reparationsanmälningar i en logg”.
+
+**Source:** “In September 2025 its own maintenance team decided to trial a shared repair log in two buildings.” “The trial lasted eight weeks.” “Elm Quay's internal trial note, 4 December 2025, says that 31 repair reports were entered.” “The trial has not yet expanded; the team will decide after checking how the categories work for larger repairs.”
+
+**Difference:** On an ordinary current-activity reading, “samlar” states collection now. The source establishes collection during the completed trial and a pending expansion decision. It does not establish ongoing collection after the trial. The issue concerns time and the state of knowledge, not the log, report type, customer agency or benefit.
+
+**Source true, current-title claim false:** The customer entered the 31 reports during its eight-week trial, then paused new log entry while examining how categories handle larger repairs. It has not expanded and has not decided yet. This scenario is compatible with every quoted source statement. No supplied statement excludes the pause. Calling the title a conventional headline present does not supply evidence that new collection continues.
+
+**Title true, historical-trial proposition false:** A customer could currently gather reports in a log without having decided on the specified September 2025 eight-week trial in two buildings—for example, by starting ordinary use in October. That would satisfy the title's bare present collection proposition but not the source's trial proposition. This reverse scenario is excluded for this particular customer by the supplied statement “In September 2025 its own maintenance team decided to trial a shared repair log in two buildings” together with “The trial lasted eight weeks.” It is therefore set aside as a scenario for this source package. The first direction remains compatible and sufficient to expose the extra current-activity claim.
+
+**Smallest supported repair:** “Elm Quay samlade reparationsanmälningar i en logg”. This retains the subject, action and title's editorial emphasis, while locating the established activity in the past. “Elm Quay prövade en gemensam reparationslogg” is also supported, but changes more wording than necessary.
+
+**Classification:** Source-support finding; not a translated-quotation defect. If the publisher intends a continuing-use assertion, new evidence that the customer continued entering reports after the trial would close the gap. That evidence is absent from this supplied package.
